description: This PHP source file defines the 'Filter' class within the Opencart admin model for catalog filtering functionality. It includes methods for managing filter groups and filters, such as adding, editing, deleting, retrieving, and counting records, along with handling descriptions in multiple languages.

classes.name: Filter
classes.description: Represents the filter model in the Opencart admin catalog module, providing methods for CRUD operations and retrieval related to filter groups and filters in the database.

methods.name: addFilterGroup
methods.description: Creates a new filter group record in the database and its descriptions in multiple languages.

methods.name: editFilterGroup
methods.description: Updates an existing filter group record and its descriptions.

methods.name: deleteFilterGroup
methods.description: Deletes a filter group and its descriptions from the database.

methods.name: getFilterGroup
methods.description: Retrieves a specific filter group record along with its description for the current language.

methods.name: getFilterGroups
methods.description: Retrieves multiple filter group records, with optional filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalFilterGroups
methods.description: Returns the total count of filter group records, optionally filtered by name.

methods.name: addDescription
methods.description: Adds a description to a filter group in a specified language.

methods.name: deleteDescriptions
methods.description: Deletes all descriptions for a specific filter group.

methods.name: deleteDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Deletes all filter group descriptions for a specific language.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Retrieves all descriptions for a filter group, indexed by language ID.

methods.name: getDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Retrieves all filter group descriptions in a specific language.

methods.name: addFilter
methods.description: Creates a new filter record with associated descriptions, in a specified filter group.

methods.name: editFilter
methods.description: Updates an existing filter record and its descriptions.

methods.name: deleteFilter
methods.description: Deletes a filter and its descriptions, as well as related records in categories and products.

methods.name: getFilter
methods.description: Retrieves a filter record, including its filter group name, for the current language.

methods.name: getFilters
methods.description: Retrieves multiple filter records with optional filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalFilters
methods.description: Counts the total number of filters, with optional filtering by name.

methods.name: getTotalFiltersByFilterGroupId
methods.description: Counts the number of filters assigned to a specific filter group.

methods.name: addFilterDescription
methods.description: Adds a description to a filter in a specific language.

methods.name: deleteFilterDescriptions
methods.description: Deletes all descriptions related to a filter.

methods.name: deleteFilterDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Deletes all filter descriptions for a specific language.

methods.name: getFilterDescriptions
methods.description: Retrieves all descriptions for a filter, indexed by language ID.

methods.name: getFilterDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Retrieves all filter descriptions in a specific language.
